Author: tishamdhar
Content: I am assembling some of these for folks in Adelaide, any spares I will list on my Tindie store. I got X10 PCB's made. I need only 1 , I currently have a loaner which I need to return, happy to bring more Nintendo things into existence. I am a bit of a copycat, I was told off at the Nintendo museum for running around and copying the artwork for their old games by hand in my sketchbook, since they don't allow photography.
